judgment.rationale: Token retention and blocked finalization now have separate source-backed investigation targets. Hypothesis: undisposed WindowsIdentity adds token handles per path lookup, while blocked WinRT finalization amplifies token, thread and other resource retention. This is an initial investigation direction, not a runtime-confirmed diagnosis.
evidence: Earlier helper-restart and periodic-trigger interpretations were explicitly corrected: desktop/socket teardown, not killing the helper, releases handles.
New reply reproduces with service mode off and clipboard off; Token growth correlates with settings saves, while reported dumps show finalization waiting in WinRT context release.
The exact COM apartment/object causing the wait remains an inference; changing every socket thread to MTA is not yet justified.
